verdict.rationale: Unity's first-party docs confirm WebGL as a build target that publishes real-time interactive 3D into a browser, and build profiles provide per-platform build configuration. That covers the 'WebGL today' part of the story. Nothing in the pack addresses payload size or WebGPU. Missing for 10: any evidence on build payload size or size optimization, any WebGPU support or roadmap, and hands-on or independent corroboration of web export quality.
